hero.eyebrow: Bridging the Gap Between Home and Specialist Literacy Support
hero.headline: Is Your Child Struggling with Reading or Phonics?
hero.subheadline: Unlock their reading potential with expert, evidence-based tuition for SEND and home-educated children.
hero.supporting_text: No more guesswork. Just targeted progress. Many bright children struggle with reading because of hidden gaps in fluency, decoding, or comprehension. Tuition uses a premium, data-driven approach to find exactly where the breakdown is happening — and fixes it.

owner.name: Nicola Mackenzie
owner.bio_intro: Nicola Mackenzie is a former Primary School Teacher, KS3 English Teacher, Secondary ELP (Enhanced Learning Provision) Specialist, and certified phonics and literacy lead.
owner.bio_extra: Grounded in lived experience as a proud SEND mum, Nicola understands both the classroom and the home. She builds a comprehensive 360° diagnostic literacy profile, then designs tailored support using specialist, age-appropriate programs — including Read Write Inc. Fresh Start phonics, That Reading Thing, Game Changers and more.

assessment.title: The Assessment Day
assessment.reassurance: This Is Not a 'Pass or Fail' Test. Please reassure your child that they cannot 'fail' this session. This assessment is simply a puzzle that helps me map out how their brain processes language.
assessment.duration_detail: Because it is conducted 1-to-1 in a quiet, relaxed space, it feels much more like an informal quiz or a game than a rigid school exam.

tools.name: The WRAT5
tools.what: Word lists, quick spelling games and short tasks — no long, intimidating stories.

tools.name: The Access Reading Test
tools.what: Short passages read silently, answered as multi-choice puzzles.

tools.name: The YARC
tools.what: Your child reads a short, specially levelled story aloud.

prep.title: Keep It Low-Key
prep.text: A calm, relaxed morning beats a big production.

prep.title: Rest and Fuel
prep.text: A good night's sleep and a protein-rich snack make a real difference.

prep.title: What to Bring
prep.text: Prescription reading glasses, a coloured overlay or a tracking ruler if your child uses these.

assessment.control_note: If your child needs a brain break, a stretch, or a glass of water, we pause immediately. They are entirely in control.
assessment.next_steps: The diagnostics are scored and a Diagnostic Baseline Profile is compiled within ~48 hours, followed by a short follow-up call to walk you through what it all means.

faq.q: What ages and key stages do you work with?
faq.a: ⚠️ TO CONFIRM — artwork is inconsistent (KS2–KS3 vs KS2–KS4). Working with KS2, KS3 and KS4 learners, including the 9–14 age range for the phonics catch-up track.

faq.q: Do you have SEND and dyslexia experience?
faq.a: Yes. Nicola is a specialist in Enhanced Learning Provision and designs all support for neurodiverse learners, dyslexic profiles and home-educated children.

faq.q: Do you work online or face-to-face?
faq.a: 1:1 tutoring is delivered face-to-face. Bridge Learning Pods are small-group sessions. Tell us your preference when you book and we'll advise what suits your child.
Typically 45 to 60 minutes, conducted 1-to-1 in a quiet, relaxed space.

It is not a pass or fail test — your child cannot fail. It feels more like an informal quiz or a game, and your child is entirely in control, including taking breaks. A Diagnostic Baseline Profile is then compiled within ~48 hours, followed by a short follow-up call.

faq.q: How quickly will I get results?
faq.a: The Diagnostic Baseline Profile is usually compiled within about 48 hours, followed by a short follow-up call to walk you through it.
